outline: The overall objective of this course is to introduce the types and functions of geosynthetics, along with their engineering applications. Specifically, this course focuses on soil reinforcement and provides students with the advanced knowledge necessary for the design, analysis, and performance evaluation of mechanically stabilized earth (MSE) walls. The course also covers topics such as construction, monitoring, maintenance, case histories, and the current state-of-the-art applications of geosynthetic-reinforced soil (GRS) structures in mitigating various natural disasters.
